hints.title: Timeline Discretization
hints.text: Collect all distinct start and end times for each employee into atomic endpoints.

hints.title: Consecutive Segments
hints.text: Form elementary consecutive intervals using offset window function window function partitioned by employee.

hints.title: Interval Concurrency
hints.text: Join segments to the Tasks table to determine the active task count and segment durations.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH TimePoints AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT employee_id, start_time AS st FROM Tasks
    UNION DISTINCT
    SELECT DISTINCT employee_id, end_time AS st FROM Tasks
),
Segments AS (
    SELECT 
        employee_id,
        st AS start_time,
        LEAD(st) OVER (PARTITION BY employee_id ORDER BY st) AS end_time
    FROM TimePoints
),
SegmentStats AS (
    SELECT 
        s.employee_id,
        s.start_time,
        s.end_time,
        COUNT(t.task_id) AS concurrent_count
    FROM Segments s
    JOIN Tasks t
      ON s.employee_id = t.employee_id
     AND s.start_time >= t.start_time
     AND s.end_time <= t.end_time
    WHERE s.end_time IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.employee_id, s.start_time, s.end_time
)
SELECT 
    employee_id,
    FLOOR(SUM(TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(end_time, start_time))) / 3600) AS total_task_hours,
    MAX(concurrent_count) AS max_concurrent_tasks
FROM SegmentStats
GROUP BY employee_id
ORDER BY employee_id;
```

complexity.notes: Sorting distinct time points and windowing takes O(n log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Overlapping intervals cannot be added directly without interval splitting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use window LEAD to break timelines into non-overlapping atomic blocks.

WITH TimePoints AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT employee_id, start_time AS st FROM Tasks
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT employee_id, end_time AS st FROM Tasks
),
Segments AS (
    SELECT 
        employee_id,
        st AS start_time,
        LEAD(st) OVER (PARTITION BY employee_id ORDER BY st) AS end_time
    FROM TimePoints
),
SegmentStats AS (
    SELECT 
        s.employee_id,
        s.start_time,
        s.end_time,
        COUNT(t.task_id) AS concurrent_count
    FROM Segments s
    JOIN Tasks t
      ON s.employee_id = t.employee_id
     AND s.start_time >= t.start_time
     AND s.end_time <= t.end_time
    WHERE s.end_time IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.employee_id, s.start_time, s.end_time
)
SELECT 
    employee_id,
    FLOOR(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_time - start_time))) / 3600)::INT AS total_task_hours,
    MAX(concurrent_count) AS max_concurrent_tasks
FROM SegmentStats
GROUP BY employee_id
ORDER BY employee_id;
